cohort: Consecutive pregnant female patients, aged 16-47 years, were included and categorized into those with or without pregnancy-associated bleeding.
finding: Vaginal bleeding during pregnancy was not associated with maternal age, parity, abortion history, or total pregnancies, but was significantly linked to a history of infertility, progesterone treatment, post-delivery bleeding, premature labor, and neonatal complications like respiratory distress and NICU admissions.
